building_name: [New Construction / Detached House] Nishi-Koiwa, Edogawa Ward, Tokyo
description: This is a newly constructed detached house located in Nishi-Koiwa, Edogawa Ward, Tokyo. Featuring a south-facing balcony, the property enjoys abundant sunlight and excellent ventilation. The interior offers generous storage solutions including a walk-in closet, along with premium modern amenities such as floor heating, a built-in dishwasher, and a bathroom ventilation dryer to streamline daily chores. Situated in a highly convenient dual-station location just a 7-minute walk from Keisei-Koiwa Station (Keisei Main Line) and a 9-minute walk from Koiwa Station (JR Sobu Line), it provides seamless access to central hubs like Tokyo, Akihabara, and Nihonbashi. Nishi-Koiwa, Edogawa Ward, Tokyo, is a popular residential enclave combining the vibrant commercial energy of ongoing station-front redevelopment with a comfortable neighborhood feel. Positioned on flat terrain within the Tokyo Lowlands near the Arakawa and Edogawa Rivers, the area offers an easy-to-navigate environment. The surrounding neighborhood is a quiet residential area designated primarily as Category I Exclusive Medium-and-High-Rise and Category I Residential Zones, lined with neat detached homes and low-rise residences. The front road accesses a paved public road.
